reader_guide: Read the grade as a judgment of the current proof of concept on the founder’s S26 Ultra. It is not a prediction that an unfamiliar customer can install and use the app. Start with the two high severity findings: speech callbacks run directly on binder threads, and the session owner’s polish fallback can itself throw before publishing text. Those are narrower, testable defects within an otherwise deliberate architecture. Next, use the ranked refactor targets to choose work. Their tiers describe the project’s change size, while severity describes what could affect the founder’s phone today. The architecture score uses the current inventory: the session logic is now in a 1,322-line coordinator, the service shell is 258 lines, and AppShell is 255 lines. The earlier extraction targets have moved. Each cited snippet is from current source; a static risk grade means the code shows a plausible exposure whose real frequency or outcome needs the named runtime experiment. No build or device test was run for this report. The not_assessed section separates stage-two work and the source and runtime coverage that this audit did not complete.

overall_grade.rationale: This is professional stage-one engineering with real debt, not AI slop. One session owner, typed outcomes, process isolation, guarded insertion, pinned models and unusually careful privacy controls are visible in working code and outcome tests. The binder callback path and an unguarded polish fallback still threaten the promise that the user always gets their words. Several large files also retain responsibilities that now have clearer owners. This is not yet a production-grade release assessment.
overall_grade.confidence_rationale: The findings have reopened source citations and concrete falsification tests. The audit did not run code or complete a line-by-line pass of every smaller priority file in the inventory, so it cannot claim an exhaustive defect count or phone behavior.

dimensions.name: Architecture integrity
dimensions.justification: The six surfaces reach one owner, and the service is now a 258-line Android shell around a 1,322-line coordinator; AppShell is 255 lines. The current mass is the coordinator, AudioCaptureService at 997 lines, PolishScreen at 892, RecordingAccessibilityOverlay at 817, SettingsPages at 776 and DictionaryScreen at 770. The coordinator still chooses notice destinations, which belongs in a per-take presentation adapter. AudioCaptureService still owns the capture reader loop and file close alongside service and legacy binder duties; a capture reader should own that work. The large screen files should be split by their existing rungs or pages. AppShell’s direct WorkManager observation is a current, checkable breach of its navigation-only purpose. No second session owner or heavy model loaded in main was found in the reviewed paths.

worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The WorkManager subscriptions and model-state derivation are directly inside the navigation shell.

dimensions.name: Concurrency discipline
dimensions.justification: Capture commands have a serial lane off main, and pushed audio events are handed to main before the owner acts. Speech and polish callback stubs take a different route: they invoke their listeners on binder threads. A blank speech result can synchronously release the target and finish a session from that thread. A polish-process disconnect can also run deterministic language detection inline on the main ServiceConnection callback. These are concrete thread-boundary gaps despite generally deliberate ownership and cancellation.

best_example.why_exemplary: It preserves command order without letting a frozen capture binder block the main thread.

worst_violation.rule_violated: kotlin-patterns.md RULE: never-block-a-binder-or-ui-thread; named Android principle: marshal binder callbacks to the owner dispatcher before touching UI-owned state
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The source explicitly states and implements direct binder-thread delivery; the coordinator’s blank and failure callbacks synchronously enter session teardown and surface operations.
worst_violation.counterfactual: An empty or failed transcription can run overlay and teardown work on a binder thread, causing a wrong-thread failure or tying up a binder worker during an accessibility handoff.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The callback has no dispatcher hop, while the owner assumes main-thread ordering for command and surface transitions.
worst_violation.falsifiability: In an instrumentation test, return empty text and a typed ASR failure through the real :asr binder; assert every surface, target-release and terminal transition runs on main and that binder callbacks return before those operations complete.
worst_violation.concurrency_interleaving: 1. Main admits and stops a take. 2. The :asr process calls IAsrCallback.onResult with blank text, or onFailure, on an app binder-pool thread. 3. SpeechProxy invokes the coordinator listener on that same thread. 4. The coordinator releases the pinned accessibility target or enters failure teardown before any main-thread post. 5. Main can process another command while those owner operations are still running on the binder thread.

dimensions.name: Error handling and observability
dimensions.justification: Most polish exits use typed reasons, one first-wins ledger and deterministic text. The owner-side fallback itself has no exception boundary around vocabulary restoration or language detection. Since that fallback is invoked precisely when the polish service is unavailable, a recoverable detector or matcher failure can end its coroutine without publishing the last good raw text. Diagnostics reviewed here generally use shape, not content; Sentry and PostHog use declared schemas.

best_example.why_exemplary: A bad answer is identified by request identity, reported as a defect and routed to a text fallback.

worst_violation.rule_violated: architecture-rules.md FACT: heart-and-limbs; kotlin-patterns.md RULE: fail-open-to-the-last-good-text
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The fallback calls injected detector and matcher work without a catch. A throwing detector can be supplied through the existing seam.
worst_violation.counterfactual: If polish fails and local deterministic restoration also throws, the user can remain in Processing without the raw words being published or inserted.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The first-wins polish decision has already been claimed, and no outer branch here converts a fallback exception into a second, safe publication.
worst_violation.falsifiability: In the coordinator rig, inject a LanguageDetector that throws, refuse the polish bind, answer ASR with nonblank words, and prove the terminal is COMPLETED with those words delivered once.

dimensions.name: Testability
dimensions.justification: The coordinator, capture controller, finalizer and insertion attempt have usable seams. The device suite includes a real microphone, shipped-model and editor boundary; the polish failure suite asserts delivered words and defects. One JUnit method is only a line-count print. It cannot turn red and should not be included in test counts as protection. A real binder-thread callback test and a throwing fallback test are missing from the reviewed sample.

best_example.why_exemplary: The real-boundary test fails visibly when the required fixture is absent instead of reporting a skipped pass.

worst_violation.rule_violated: testing-philosophy.md RULE: every-test-declares-which-of-four-things-it-protects; named principle: a test must be able to fail when its asserted property breaks
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The method has no assertion or failure path beyond incidental file-reading failure before it runs.
worst_violation.counterfactual: A test count includes one green row even if the service or coordinator doubles in size.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The method reports a metric but does not enforce any behavior or structural property.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Double either source file’s line count without breaking compilation and run this JUnit method; a meaningful test of size would turn red.

dimensions.name: Code hygiene and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Naming and typed state are generally deliberate, and the recent service and shell splits are real. Some comments still describe obsolete mechanisms. The service retains an Android 12 vibrator fallback even though minSdk is 33, and its comment claims a silent loss on the oldest supported phone that cannot occur. PolishScreen’s 892 lines combine rung navigation, write tracking, provider controls and development model presentation; those existing sections are a better extraction target than the now-small AppShell.

best_example.why_exemplary: The data class deliberately prevents routine string interpolation from printing dictated text.

worst_violation.rule_violated: code-gotchas.md RULE: vibratormanager-is-api-31-and-minsdk-is-30; named principle: comments and compatibility branches must describe reachable behavior
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The project declares minSdk 33, and the rule file itself identifies this SDK branch as dead.
worst_violation.counterfactual: A maintainer may spend review and test effort preserving an unreachable fallback and trust a misleading explanation of supported-phone behavior.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The condition is always true on supported versions, while the comment treats the else branch as a real safeguard.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Inspect the app’s minSdk and run a supported-device instrumentation test that reaches the else branch.

dimensions.name: API surface
dimensions.justification: The production capture binding uses a five-operation AIDL contract, while the long legacy contract remains declared for append-only compatibility. The two parcelables carry policy and text rather than recorded audio. Kotlin top-level visibility is mostly narrowed, but the Android-constructed accessibility service exposes debug-only and lifecycle helper methods publicly through its companion when their known callers are inside the app module.

best_example.why_exemplary: The production transaction surface is narrow and its compatibility rule is explicit.

worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The method is public by Kotlin default, and its comment names a single debug-only caller in the same Gradle module.
worst_violation.counterfactual: Production code can call an expensive whole-window dump through an API that should be scoped to the debug receiver.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: Public visibility advertises the method throughout the module and to Java callers without expressing its debug-only purpose.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Make windowTreeXml internal and compile the app and debug source set; an external required caller would make that change fail.

dimensions.name: Performance and latency
dimensions.justification: The capture process pushes levels and take events, and the recorder and bubble are Android Views, so Compose recomposition is not their drawing bottleneck. The service displays Starting before it waits for settings, but it does not bind audio until both settings readers answer or the 2,000 ms bound expires, the matcher compiles, the policy loads and the journal gets up to another 300 ms. Normal reads may be fast; static code cannot establish the founder’s trigger-to-first-frame distribution. S1 is warmed at connect while ASR may be resident, making measured memory and warm-up behavior important.

best_example.why_exemplary: The worker parks between pushed events and exits on close without an idle poll.

worst_violation.rule_violated: Named principle: bound optional setup work on the trigger-to-capture critical path
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The sequential order and explicit 2,000 ms and 300 ms waits are in source; their real frequency is unmeasured here.
worst_violation.counterfactual: On a slow or silent settings read, the pill says Starting while microphone capture has not begun for roughly two seconds, possibly longer if later work is slow.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: Audio binding sits after the readers, matcher, policy and journal wait rather than immediately after command admission.
worst_violation.falsifiability: On the S26, inject a settings flow that does not answer, record command admission and first nonzero AudioRecord frame over repeated takes, and show the startup remains within the product’s accepted bound.

dimensions.name: Resource lifecycle
dimensions.justification: The decided Bluetooth hold is explicitly 30 seconds, plays a zero-filled buffer and releases its route through an idempotent end. Foreground service and binder teardown have named owners. The remaining static question is the silence writer: stop marks it stopped and stops/releases AudioTrack, but does not await or otherwise observe the writer thread’s exit. Whether Android always unblocks a blocked write on the S26 needs a forced-failure device test.

best_example.why_exemplary: One end wins, the track and route are released, and the approved hold has a fixed duration.

worst_violation.rule_violated: Named principle: a resource owner must observe or bound the shutdown of threads it creates
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The missing exit observation is certain. A persistent thread depends on how this device’s AudioTrack.write responds to stop and release.
worst_violation.counterfactual: If a platform write remains blocked, each completed Bluetooth hold can leave a WarmHoldSilence thread behind after its track and service lifetime end.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The owner stores the Thread but stop neither checks liveness nor arranges an off-main bounded cleanup or process fallback.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Force a blocking or failing AudioTrack.write during repeated hold expiry, handover and service destroy on the S26; verify each WarmHoldSilence thread exits and the communication route closes.
worst_violation.concurrency_interleaving: 1. The silence writer enters AudioTrack.write on its own thread. 2. The 30-second expiry or service destroy calls stop on the route or main thread. 3. stop marks the writer stopped, then calls AudioTrack.stop and release. 4. If the platform write does not return, SilenceWriter never checks its stopped flag again and the owner does not observe or bound that thread’s exit.

dimensions.name: Security and privacy
dimensions.justification: The reviewed network-facing path has a declared PostHog property allowlist and a Sentry shape schema that removes exception messages, unknown fields and content-bearing stack context. Provider keys are encrypted with Android Keystore AES-GCM, model descriptors pin revisions, sizes and SHA-256 values, and GenieX logging is silenced before initialization. Clipboard restore checks ownership. The audit found no new static violation of the network privacy boundary. A device-level egress and logcat probe is still needed before a public privacy claim is treated as runtime proof.

best_example.why_exemplary: The final Sentry event seam drops open-ended content before transmission.

refactor_targets.title: Make the owner-side polish fallback non-throwing
refactor_targets.rule_violated: architecture-rules.md FACT: heart-and-limbs; kotlin-patterns.md RULE: fail-open-to-the-last-good-text
refactor_targets.fix_shape: In TakePolishController, replace fallBack’s direct deterministic call with a function returning PreparedText.Fallback. Catch Exception around vocabulary restoration, language detection and cleanup; on failure preserve the last successful prepared text, or rawText if none exists, record one defect and invoke onPrepared exactly once. Add a coordinator-rig outcome test with a throwing LanguageDetector.

refactor_targets.title: Marshal speech and polish callbacks before owner transitions
refactor_targets.rule_violated: kotlin-patterns.md RULE: never-block-a-binder-or-ui-thread; named Android principle: binder callbacks must cross into their owner dispatcher
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Have PipelineBindings SpeechProxy and PolishProxy post received callback values to the session owner’s main dispatcher before invoking listeners. Keep binder stubs as transport only. Move expensive fallback preparation to the service-owned IO scope and post only the final publication decision to main. Add a real-binder callback test for blank speech, typed failure and polish disconnect.

refactor_targets.title: Keep polish-loss language detection off the main thread
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Change TakePolishController.disconnected to claim the request and record the loss synchronously, then launch deterministic preparation on its existing IO scope; return to the owner dispatcher only to publish the prepared text. Preserve the existing first-wins ledger check after the dispatcher hop.

refactor_targets.title: Move Polish model work observation out of AppShell
refactor_targets.rule_violated: architecture-rules.md RULE: keep-central-types-thin; architecture.md FACT: source-map
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Move both WorkManager flows and workUiState projection from AppShell into the Polish feature’s view model or a model-readiness owner. Expose one ModelUiState through AppUiState, activate observation only while the Polish destination is visible, and let AppShell pass that state to the badge and page.

refactor_targets.title: Separate session notice presentation from the coordinator
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Introduce a per-session SessionNoticePresenter in ui, injected beside RecorderSurface. Move the pill-versus-toast choice and dispatch from DictationSessionCoordinator.sayWhileRecording and sayAfterRecording into that presenter. The coordinator continues to select typed notice reasons and remains the only session owner.

refactor_targets.title: Bound and observe Bluetooth silence-writer shutdown
refactor_targets.rule_violated: Named principle: a resource owner must observe or bound the shutdown of threads it creates
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Make AudioTrackSilence own one tracked writer completion signal. After stop marks SilenceWriter stopped and stops/releases AudioTrack, arrange a bounded exit check on the route worker, never main or a binder thread; if it remains blocked, record one content-free defect and end the audio process before admitting another hold. Test expiry, handover, device removal and destroy with a blocked-write fake.

refactor_targets.title: Measure and narrow the pre-capture startup chain
refactor_targets.rule_violated: Named principle: bound optional setup work on the trigger-to-capture critical path
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Add content-free admission, settings-answer, matcher-ready, bind and first-frame timestamps to the existing take facts. If the S26 probe shows material delay, stop awaiting journal admission before binding because the queue already preserves order, and cache the last successfully compiled vocabulary matcher in SessionPreferencesSource so a take only compiles changed terms. Keep the first-take settings answer and its two-second fallback semantics.

refactor_targets.title: Split the Polish screen by its existing rungs
refactor_targets.rule_violated: Named principle: one screen file should not own unrelated presentation sections
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Move CloudRungs, ModelRung and the provider-key controls from the 892-line PolishScreen.kt into PolishCloudRungs.kt; move S1Card, S1ControlCard and DevelopmentModelCard into PolishLocalControls.kt. refactor_targets.title: Remove unreachable vibrator compatibility code
refactor_targets.fix_shape: In DictationSessionService.vibrate, use VibratorManager directly under the existing runCatching and delete the SDK_INT branch, legacy Vibrator lookup and misleading comment. Keep the system haptic-setting gate at the cue.

refactor_targets.fix_shape: Mark PasteAccessibilityService.windowTreeXml internal and keep its only caller in the debug source set. Do not change any AIDL transaction or the Android-visible service class.

phased_roadmap.title: Protect the words and callback boundary
phased_roadmap.rationale: These targets have no dependencies. The fallback fix comes first within the phase because later callback changes must preserve its one-publication outcome. The static resource and latency proposals should be shaped by their named phone probes before code changes.

phased_roadmap.title: Normalize callback dispatch
phased_roadmap.rationale: With fallback failure contained, move binder callback work to the owner’s dispatcher and verify blank speech and typed failure on a real binder.

phased_roadmap.title: Finish polish-loss scheduling
phased_roadmap.rationale: After callbacks have a declared dispatcher, keep language detection on IO and preserve the ledger’s first-wins publication.

strengths.pattern_name: One session owner behind injectable seams
strengths.why_preserve: The shell wires a single coordinator and a cancellable service scope.
A frozen audio binder cannot park the main-thread silence bound.

strengths.pattern_name: One insertion write followed by evidence-based judgment
strengths.why_preserve: It avoids a second write after an ambiguous editor action.
The decided behavior has a fixed duration and one route-release transition.
Revision, source path, size and SHA-256 are all required before a descriptor is available.
It drops open-ended fields and exception messages at the Sentry send seam.
AES-GCM uses a Keystore key and binds ciphertext to provider identity.
A missing fixture fails rather than becoming a misleading green skip.

least_confident_finding.why_low_confidence: The absence of an exit check is visible, but Android may always unblock AudioTrack.write when this track is stopped and released on the founder’s device.

top_not_assessed_gap.gap: Whether failures still deliver the last successful text through real binders and the real accessibility editor
top_not_assessed_gap.runtime_test_required: On the S26, run a nonblank take into a real editor while killing :polish, forcing a detector failure, and returning blank or failed ASR callbacks through the separate processes; inspect the editor, clipboard, notice and one terminal record.
top_not_assessed_gap.why_this_matters_for_heart_limbs: The central promise is an outcome at the editor. Static fallbacks and JVM fakes cannot prove that callbacks, process death and accessibility delivery preserve it on the phone.
